explanation: Beavers fell trees with front teeth that never stop growing. The teeth are orange because their enamel contains iron, which makes it tougher and harder for acid to wear away.

claims.text: Beavers build dams of branches and mud across streams, creating ponds where they build their lodges.
Otters, muskrats and water voles do not build dams.
Beavers' front teeth grow continuously throughout life.
Beaver tooth enamel is orange because it contains iron, which makes it tougher and more resistant to acid.
